BiblicalUsage: Tyre is the great Phoenician port on the Mediterranean, the city of King Hiram. In Joshua 19:29, to the strong city Tyre. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that a place like Tyre is worth knowing because God's story unfolded there.
